name: Napa and Sonoma valleys
description: Joint Napa-Sonoma frame: the Napa Valley AVA bounding box (UC Davis AVA Project) padded by 2 km, widened west to the Santa Rosa Plain (Fountaingrove, Chalk Hill, Bennett Valley, Sonoma Mountain) and south to cover the Sonoma Valley AVA; ~76 x 77 km. Frame for the viewer, not a geological boundary. The id stays napa_valley so existing links keep working.
ava_rule: the parent AVAs plus every current AVA whose bounding box lies inside the frame
